# Yapp 0.1.3
- Added a charcoal-and-golden-amber macOS app icon and matching browser favicon. - Unified the app indicator and website around golden amber #F4B241. - Moved Check for Updates… directly below About, with a separator beneath it.
Apple silicon · macOS 14 or later · English. Dictation stays fully offline. Update checks remain manual only. Use Check for Updates… in Yapp 0.1.2 or newer, or install the DMG. Users on 0.1.1 and earlier need the DMG once to get the updater.

# Yapp 0.1.2
- Added Check for Updates… with native check, download, install, and relaunch UI. - Checks are manual only. No automatic checks, background downloads, installs, or system profiling. Dictation continues to work fully offline. - Update archives are cryptographically signed and verified before extraction.
Apple silicon · macOS 14 or later · English. Users of 0.1.1 and earlier must install this version from the DMG once to get the new updater.
